_comment: KRW net PnL report settings (ADR-0036). Tax values are an ESTIMATE of current 소득세법 (가상자산 소득, 시행 2027-01-01, 22%, 기본공제 250만원, 같은 해 손익통산·이월공제 없음); verified stays false until a tax accountant confirms futures-PnL treatment and the cost method. null exit costs = not configured: the report says 'unavailable' instead of assuming zero. Fill them from the exchanges' own fee pages (they change by network and over time).
